title: Local-state policy
responsibility: Decide and enforce where session transcripts, consent records, compatibility results and setup journals live: by default under the outer project's ignored `.pi/sessions/` and `.pi/runtime/`, or, when explicitly selected, under an external per-user root derived from the committed non-secret project ID. Refuse to write any runtime data before the chosen location's protection is in place, and never commit an absolute user path in order to reach it.
notes: ⚠️ THE EXTERNAL MODE DEPENDS ON A CAPABILITY NOBODY HAS PROVED. Relocating Pi's session directory outside the project must be achievable through a supported Pi option or API; if the pinned version cannot do it, this component's second mode does not exist and the design changes rather than substituting a committed absolute path.
